fields.name: url
fields.label: Site URL
fields.description: e.g. https://wearetool.com

fields.name: contactEmail
fields.label: Contact email
fields.description: Shown on the contact page

fields.name: contactFormKey
fields.label: Contact form access key (Web3Forms)
fields.description: Free key from web3forms.com. Empty shows an email link instead.

fields.name: homeTitle
fields.label: Homepage meta title suffix
fields.description: Browser tab title: "SiteName | <this text>"

fields.name: footerToolLimit
fields.label: Tools listed per footer column
fields.description: The rest stay on the category page behind View all. Default 5.

fields.name: verificationTags
fields.label: Header code: verification meta tags
fields.description: Google, Bing, Pinterest and similar. Paste the two values, not the whole tag.

fields.name: name
fields.label: name=
fields.description: e.g. google-site-verification

fields.name: content
fields.label: content=
fields.description: the long code the service gave you

fields.name: headScripts
fields.label: Header code: external scripts
fields.description: AdSense, analytics and similar. The URL only.

fields.name: crossorigin
fields.label: crossorigin value
fields.description: Usually "anonymous" for AdSense. Leave empty otherwise.

fields.name: analyticsId
fields.label: Google Analytics measurement ID
fields.description: Just the ID, like G-XXXXXXXXXX. Empty turns analytics off.

fields.name: inlineHeadCode
fields.label: Header code: inline JavaScript
fields.description: Code only, no <script> tags.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: {toolCount} is replaced with the live number of tools

fields.name: noResults
fields.label: No-results message
fields.description: {query} = what the visitor typed

fields.name: heroEyebrow
fields.label: Hero status line
fields.description: The small line above the headline, next to the pulsing dot

fields.name: toolsGrowing
fields.label: Tool count text
fields.description: {count} = number of tools

fields.name: viewAll
fields.label: "View all" link
fields.description: {count} = number of tools

fields.name: toolsCount
fields.label: Category card count text
fields.description: {count} = number of tools

fields.name: subSuffix
fields.label: Line under tool title (after short description)

fields.name: whyHeading
fields.label: "Why use our..." heading
fields.description: {name} = tool name

fields.name: toolsPill
fields.label: Tool count pill
fields.description: {count} = number of tools

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: The line icon shown for this category. Leave it empty and the emoji below is used instead.

fields.name: paragraphs
fields.label: Paragraphs
fields.description: 300-400 words. [links](/path/) allowed.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: The line icon shown on cards, in search and beside the title. Leave it empty and the emoji below is used instead, so a new tool is never iconless.

fields.name: related
fields.label: Related tools (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty and the site works these out on its own. To force a pairing, add tool filenames like image-resizer, one per item.

fields.name: short
fields.label: Short description
fields.description: Used on cards and in search

fields.name: code
fields.label: Tool code
fields.description: Leave empty for the nine original tools, which are built in

fields.name: html
fields.label: HTML
fields.description: The interface. No <style> or <script> tags.

fields.name: css
fields.label: CSS
fields.description: Optional. Rules only, no <style> tags.

fields.name: js
fields.label: JavaScript
fields.description: The logic. Code only, no <script> tags.

fields.name: needsNetwork
fields.label: This tool calls an API
fields.description: Leave OFF for anything that can be done on the device, which is most tools. Turning it on loosens the sandbox so the tool can reach the internet, and it means this tool no longer honours the 'nothing leaves your device' promise.

fields.name: apiName
fields.label: Which API
fields.description: The service this tool depends on, for example 'exchangerate.host' or 'Open-Meteo'. Recorded so you can see at a glance which tools would break if a service disappears.

fields.name: apiDocs
fields.label: API docs link
fields.description: Where to look when it stops working. Paste the documentation URL.

fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: API key
fields.description: Read in the tool as WT.config.apiKey. WARNING: this is published in the page source and anyone can read it, so only ever use a key that is restricted to your own domain, and never a secret or billing key.

fields.name: apiBaseUrl
fields.label: API base URL
fields.description: Optional. Read it as WT.config.apiBaseUrl

fields.name: apiFreeTier
fields.label: Free limits
fields.description: What the free plan allows, for example '1000 requests a day, no card needed'. Worth writing down now rather than rediscovering it when the tool starts failing.

fields.name: content
fields.label: Page content
fields.description: The article below the tool

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro paragraphs
fields.description: Primary keyword in the first sentence

fields.name: howto
fields.label: How-to steps
fields.description: One step per item

fields.name: title
fields.label: Page heading
fields.description: {siteName} is replaced with the site name

fields.name: metaTitle
fields.label: Meta title (also the footer link text)

fields.name: noindex
fields.label: Hide from Google
fields.description: Page still works and stays in the footer, just kept out of Google.

fields.name: showContactForm
fields.label: Show the contact form on this page

options.label: Do not show in the footer

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro paragraphs
fields.description: Shown larger, before the first heading

fields.name: paragraphs
fields.label: Paragraphs
fields.description: Supports {siteName}, **bold** and [links](/path/)

fields.name: body
fields.label: Extra paragraphs (legacy)
fields.description: Older format, still rendered

fields.name: excerpt
fields.label: Summary
fields.description: Shown on the blog index and used as the description if the SEO one is empty.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Published date
fields.description: Write it as 2026-08-05. Used for sorting and shown on the article.

fields.name: readMinutes
fields.label: Reading time in minutes
fields.description: Leave empty and it is worked out from the word count.

fields.name: cover
fields.label: Featured image
fields.description: Optional. Leave it empty and a cover is drawn from the title, which means an article is never published without one. Around 1200 by 630 works best if you do upload.

fields.name: coverAlt
fields.label: Featured image description
fields.description: What the image shows, for screen readers and for Google.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Related category
fields.description: Colours the article and decides which tools appear beside it.

fields.name: relatedTools
fields.label: Tools to show beside the article
fields.description: Tool filenames like image-compressor, one per item. Leave empty and the category's tools are used.

fields.name: outbound
fields.label: Outbound link
fields.description: One link to a genuinely authoritative source. It signals to Google that the article is researched rather than spun.

fields.name: paragraphs
fields.label: Paragraphs
fields.description: [links](/tools/slug/) and **bold** work

fields.name: callout
fields.label: Highlighted note (optional)
fields.description: Pulled out in a box. One per section at most, or they stop standing out.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
